name: @ship/chrome
description: Ship Chrome pack — the RUNTIME-COUPLED ship-* shell-chrome components: command bar + command palette (SDK search/sessions/agents/chat), activity bar, status bar, dock + dock app, home dock, rail, and the filled nav-top (subscribes to ship.account.state() and wires the SDK-free @ship/sail-primitives <sui-account-menu>). Controllers reach for the SDK/router/live data and emit the shell intents (ship-mode-change, ship-submit, ship-select, ship-context-change, ship-launch). Purely-presentational shells (<ship-app-chrome>, the <sui-tree>-composing <ship-file-tree>) live in @ship/shared (runtime-free); the host owns wiring to the daemon.
